title: In JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before 2026.3 code execution was possible via the unauthenticated JDBC worker RMI endpoint…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before version 2026.3 allows code execution via an unauthenticated JDBC worker RMI endpoint. This flaw could enable an attacker with local access to execute arbitrary code. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.7.
